body: Orchestrator (DM-171 review): recording a 500-observation batch takes 10-19 s on this Windows machine; 91% is the post-commit outbox flush exporting one file per observation (`exportObservation`, src/core/repo/finalizer.ts:544 -> `writeOnce`/`writeFileSafely`: temp write, fsync, rename, read-back, plus `assertContained` checks at ~33%), about 21-28 ms per observation. Introduced by DM-170 (accepted). Candidate for the retro; tests that record large batches pay this per observation.
